verdict.rationale: Productboard says it can push prioritized features into delivery and track their status (docs-20), and Spark can check Linear project progress (intdir-7). Webhooks give real-time change notifications (docs-5, docs-32, docs-33), but this is a developer integration, not a PM-facing live status view. missing for 10: a per-task real-time status view for PMs, visibility into what a task is blocked on, a last-update timestamp per task, and hands-on corroboration.
